indexes.name: audit_events_entity_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX audit_events_entity_idx ON public.audit_events USING btree (org_id, entity_type, entity_id)

triggers.name: audit_events_append_only
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_audit_mutation()

triggers.name: audit_events_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_events_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.audit_events FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_audit_mutation()

checks.name: expenses_complete_when_ready
checks.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['processing'::expense_status, 'needs_review'::expense_status])) OR ((amount_minor IS NOT NULL) AND (currency IS NOT NULL) AND (transaction_date IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: expenses_fx_complete
checks.definition: CHECK ((((fx_rate IS NULL) AND (fx_rate_date IS NULL) AND (fx_source IS NULL)) OR ((fx_rate IS NOT NULL) AND (fx_rate_date IS NOT NULL) AND (fx_source IS NOT NULL) AND (home_amount_minor IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: expenses_report_only_when_local
checks.definition: CHECK (((report_id IS NULL) OR (trip_id IS NULL)))

policies.name: own_memberships
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM member_sign_ins s
  WHERE ((s.org_id = members.org_id) AND (s.member_id = members.id) AND (s.user_id = app_current_user()))))

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_unpublished_idx ON public.outbox_events USING btree (created_at) WHERE (published_at IS NULL)
